fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Action for Mechanised Sanitation Ecosystem (NAMASTE) - "Emergency Response Sanitation Unit (ERSU) Formation and Functionalisation"
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to establish professional, well-trained, motivated and adequately equipped workforce for maintenance and management of sewers and septic tanks, addressing the critical need to eliminate fatalities resulting from workers entering sewers and septic tanks without proper safety measures.

fields.schemeName: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme- For Incubators
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)” was launched by the DPIIT on 19th April 2021 to provide financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market-entry, and commercialization.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Reimbursement of Testing and Certification Charges for Start-ups and Telecom MSEs
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reimburse testing and certification costs. Financial support is provided to Start-ups and MSEs to enhance telecom product competitiveness.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Scheme (PLI) for IT Hardware
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to boost domestic manufacturing and attract investment in IT hardware. Through this scheme, financial incentives are provided to eligible manufacturers based on incremental sales.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
fields.schemeName: Livestock Health and Diseases Control
fields.briefDescription: The Livestock Health and Diseases Control (LH&DC) scheme is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme (CSS) implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India.

fields.schemeName: Amended Technology Upgradation Fund
fields.briefDescription: The Ministry of Textiles introduced the Amended Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (ATUFS). This scheme aims to facilitate investment, employment, productivity, quality and import and export substitution in the textile industry.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions
fields.schemeName: National Awards for e-Governance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize excellence in e-governance. It provides awards and incentives up to ₹10,00,000 to outstanding initiatives.

fields.schemeName: Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize excellent work done by individuals and institutions in the field of disaster management including prevention, mitigation, preparedness, response, and rehabilitation.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Quality Enhancement
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support micro and small enterprises in obtaining quality and system certifications or IPRs. It offers up to 50% reimbursement of certification costs with a ceiling of ₹3,00,000.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance For Promotion Of Guru-Shishya Parampara (Repertory Grant)
fields.briefDescription: This scheme provides financial support to organizations preserving traditional performing arts through the Guru–Shishya tradition and ensures continuity of cultural heritage through training and mentorship.

fields.schemeName: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Support for Group Nurseries" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to provide growers with high-quality coffee seedlings to ensure the proper establishment of plantations.

fields.schemeName: Access to Knowledge for Technology Development and Dissemination (A2K+)
fields.briefDescription: Access to Knowledge for Technology Development and Dissemination (A2K+) is a scheme targeted towards developing mechanisms to disseminate science, technology and innovation-related information to industries, research and academic institutions

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Food Processing Industry
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote food manufacturing, branding, and employment. Through this scheme, financial incentives and branding support are provided to food processing entities.

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Millet Based Products
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to increase usage of millets and promote value-added millet products. Through this scheme, financial incentives on incremental sales are provided to eligible manufacturers.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Assistance for Industrial Infrastructure-DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support for improvement of infrastructure in OIDC/Non-OIDC Estates /Private Estates / Industrial Areas.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: International Cooperation Scheme- Capacity Building of First Time MSE Exporters
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “International Cooperation Scheme” was launched by the MSME, Govt. of India with the aim to capacity build MSMEs for entering export market by providing reimbursement of various costs incurred by first time MSE exporters on export shipments.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Mission Solar Charkha
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Mission Solar Charkha” a pilot project was implemented by the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India. The scheme envisages setting up of Solar Charkha Clusters which would mean a focal village and other surrounding villages in a radius of 8 to 10 Kilometres.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Design Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
fields.briefDescription: Design scheme will help MSMEs to avail advice on all aspects of design. It helps MSMEs realize and achieve their design-related objectives. This specialist advice will be provided by experienced designers for new product development as well as enhancing existing product portfolio.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Deen Dayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The umbrella Central Sector Scheme of this Ministry called the "Scheme to Promote Voluntary Action for Persons with Disabilities" was revised w.e.f. 01.04.2003 and was renamed as the "Deendayal Disabled Rehabilitation Scheme (DDRS)"

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
fields.schemeName: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
fields.briefDescription: Launched in August 2008, Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is a credit-linked subsidy scheme, administered by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME). PMEGP aims to generate employment opportunities through the establishment of micro-enterprises in

fields.schemeName: Industrial R&D Promotion Programme: Recognition Of In-House R&D Units
fields.briefDescription: DSIR is operating a scheme called "Recognition of In-House R&D Units" with the objective of granting recognition & registration to in-house R&D units established by the corporate industry. The In-house R&D units are expected to be engaged in innovative research & development activities.

fields.schemeName: Institutional Support for Development and Marketing of Tribal Products/Produce
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Institutional Support for development and Marketing of Tribal Products/Produce” was introduced in 2014-15 by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses - DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: “Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/ Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses'' under “Saraswati Vidya Yojana”, implemented by the Directorate of Education,  Of DNH & DD, aims to provide financial assistance to girl students pursuing higher education in professional courses.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Fisheries,Animal Husbandry and Dairying
fields.schemeName: National Livestock Mission: Genetic Improvement of Pig Breeds - Import of Exotic Pig Germplasm
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to enhance indigenous pig productivity through genetic upgradation. The scheme supports the establishment of pig semen collection and processing labs and the import of exotic pig germplasm.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Skilling and Employability Transformation through Upgraded ITIs (PM‑SETU) : Component I
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to upgrade ITIs into industry-led institutions. Through this scheme, infrastructure, training, and employment-oriented benefits are provided to trainees.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: Vanchit Ikai Samooh aur Vargon ki Aarthik Sahayata Yojana (VISVAS) for Self-Help Groups
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide the benefit of a lower rate of interest to eligible Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and individual beneficiaries belonging to Scheduled Castes (SCs), Other Backward Classes (OBCs), and Safai Karamcharis (including identified Manual Scavengers, Waste Pickers, and their dependents).

fields.schemeName: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Startups
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme to improve access to collateral-free debt funding for DPIIT-recognised startups by providing credit guarantees on eligible loan and debt facilities, thereby encouraging institutional lending and supporting startup growth and innovation.

fields.schemeName: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad Trophy Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The MAKA Trophy instituted in year 1956-57 is a rolling trophy awarded by the Ministry of Sports to the overall top performing University in sports of the preceding year for promoting competitive sports in the university sector with a view to arouse keen interest among students.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: National Mission on Edible Oils- Oil Palm
fields.briefDescription: The Mission was launched with the aim to enhance the edible oilseeds production and oils availability in the country by harnessing Oil Palm area expansion, increasing CPO production and to reduce import burden on edible oils.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0- Special Projects
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to address the skilling needs of marginalised groups and difficult geographies. Project-based short-term skill training is provided to such candidates.

fields.schemeName: Khelo India Scheme: Promotion of Inclusiveness through Sports
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote social inclusion, gender equality, peace, development, and participation in sports by supporting rural and indigenous games, sports for women, persons with disabilities, and youth in disturbed areas across the country.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Culture of Science: Science Centre (Category-I, Category-II, Category-III)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme component aims to promote hands-on "doing science" through experimental, self-discovery exhibits. Financial assistance for capital costs and corpus fund under three categories is provided to State/Union Territory Governments and their Societies.

fields.schemeName: Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The "Mukhya Mantri Balika Poshak Yojna" is a government initiative launched to encourage the enrollment and retention of girl students in schools by providing them with school uniforms.

fields.schemeName: Rajya Dairy Udhyamita Vikas Yojna
fields.briefDescription: The "Rajya Dairy Udhyamita Vikas Yojna", under the Animal Husbandry Department of Chhattisgarh, aims to promote dairy entrepreneurship among youth. With the increasing demand for milk and dairy products, the scheme supports high-breed cow/buffalo rearing as a profitable business.

fields.schemeName: State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "State Goat Entrepreneurship Development Scheme", initiated by the Animal Husbandry Department of Chhattisgarh, aims to promote goat farming as a sustainable livelihood option. Goat rearing has been a traditional occupation, and with increasing demand for milk and meat.

fields.schemeName: Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence " is aimed at promoting self-employment opportunities across all communities in Gujarat through practical and theoretical learning at the Centre of Excellence.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

fields.schemeName: Working Women Hostel
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Working Women Hostel" by the Women and Child Development Department, Government of Haryana aims to provide safe and affordable accommodation to working women. Through this scheme, hostel facilities at subsidized rent are provided to employed women.

fields.schemeName: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up small-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Financial Assistance to New Writers of Gujarati Language and Literature for Publishing Original Works of Creative and Fine Literature
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to financially support new writers in the Gujarati language who wish to publish original works of creative and literary merit.

fields.schemeName: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Purchase of Fishing Nets (Scheduled Caste)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals from Scheduled Caste families engaged in fishing activities for the purchase of fishing nets. Under this scheme, a 60% subsidy or up to ₹24,000, on the purchase of fishing nets worth ₹40,000/- will be provided to eligible beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: NEW SWARNIMA (Gopalak Nigam)
fields.briefDescription: Self-employment loan scheme for Rabari and Bharwad women in Gujarat, offering up to ₹2 lakh at 5% annual interest to promote economic independence.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Horticulture Kit to Urban and Rural Areas
fields.briefDescription: Through this scheme, all the horticulture growers in rural & urban areas are provided with a horticulture kit worth ₹ 3,000 per kit to urban and rural areas, during Aadipattam/Thaipattam, through the Additional Director of Agriculture (Horticulture).

fields.schemeName: Male Pig Distribution Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The "Male Pig Distribution Scheme", under the Animal Husbandry Department, Government of  Chhattisgarh, provides a grant to beneficiaries from the SC/ST category for purchasing one male pig of an improved breed (Middle White Yorkshire).

fields.schemeName: Paddy Transplantor Machine se Dhan Ropayee par Anudan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote mechanized paddy transplantation under the Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare and Biotechnology Department, Chhattisgarh. It provides ₹3,000 per acre for land preparation, including ploughing and weeding, up to 2 hectares.

fields.schemeName: Capacity Building For Service Providers - Entrepreneurship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Entrepreneurship Programme" is a Suo-Moto Sub-Scheme of the Ministry of Tourism under the Umbrella Scheme of "Capacity Building for Service Providers". In this scheme financial assistance is provided to the institutes (given below) to conduct entrepreneurship development programs.

fields.schemeName: Inter-state Border Areas Development Programme
fields.briefDescription: The aims and objectives of the Inter-State Border Areas Development Programme ISBADP are to provide facilities for the socioeconomic development of the people living along the Inter-State boundary with Assam.

fields.schemeShortTitle: CHIEF MINISTER SUSTAINABLE AGRICULTURE IRRIGATION SCHEME
fields.schemeName: Chief Minister Sustainable Agriculture Irrigation Scheme - Magel Tyala Shettale (Individual Farm Pond)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme subsidy payable to individual farmer is minimum Rs.14433/- and maximum Rs.75000/- depending on the size of the farm pond.

fields.schemeName: Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme
fields.briefDescription: ‘Kisan Vikas Patra Scheme’ was relaunched in the year 2014 by the Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry Of Finance, Government of India in view of the popular demand and to revitalize Small Savings. The amount invested in Kisan Vikas Patra (KYP) doubles in 115 months at the present rate.

fields.schemeName: Punjabi Language Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: This scheme awards scholarships to students based on their merit in the Punjabi subject in the 8th and 10th class examinations conducted by the Haryana Board of School Education, provided they continue studying the Punjabi subject in the 9th and 11th classes.
